landing.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about Fantasy Reality
landing.faq1Q: How do I create a fantasy game for my show?
landing.faq1A: Simply sign up, enter your show details, add participants, and set up scoring rules. Our intuitive interface guides you through each step.
landing.faq2Q: Can fans play on mobile devices?
landing.faq2A: Absolutely! Our platform is fully responsive and works seamlessly on smartphones, tablets, and desktops.
landing.faq3Q: How does the game rules work?
landing.faq3A: You define custom scoring rules based on events in your show. Points are automatically calculated when you log events during episodes.
landing.faq4A: Yes! Premium plans include full white-label options with your show's colors, logos, and custom domain.
landing.faq5Q: Is there a limit to how many players can join?
landing.faq5A: Free plans support up to 100 players. Professional and Enterprise plans offer unlimited players.
landing.faq6A: We offer community support for free plans, priority email support for Professional, and 24/7 dedicated support for Enterprise.
landing.footerCtaDesc: Join thousands of shows already using Fantasy Reality to engage their audiences.

b2cLanding.heroSubtitle: Compete with fellow fans. Track your predictions. Win bragging rights.
b2cLanding.aboutDescription: This is your chance to become part of the action. The {{show}} game lets you predict weekly outcomes, track scores, and climb the leaderboard — all while engaging with your favorite show like never before.
b2cLanding.aboutItem1: Predict what happens in {{show}} based on predefined rules
b2cLanding.aboutItem3: Get even more involved with your favorite TV show
b2cLanding.howItWorksSubtitle: Follow these simple steps to start competing and winning.
b2cLanding.step1Desc: Choose who you think will win, get eliminated, or cause drama.
b2cLanding.step2Desc: Get rewarded for accurate picks each week.
b2cLanding.step3Desc: Create your account and get your fantasy picks ready.
b2cLanding.step4Desc: Compete with others and aim for the top spot.
b2cLanding.faqQ1: What is Fantasy {{show}}, and how does the game work?
b2cLanding.faqA1: Fantasy {{show}} is a fantasy game inspired by Fantasy Football, created for {{show}}. Players create their own team by selecting real contestants from the show. Each week, you earn points based on how your selected contestants behave on the show—whether they win competitions, stir up drama, or get eliminated, it all affects your score.
b2cLanding.faqQ2: How do I sign up and start playing?
b2cLanding.faqA2: Simply click the 'Join Now' button at the top of the page to create your account. Once registered, you can immediately start building your fantasy team and joining leagues to compete with other fans.
b2cLanding.faqQ3: How many contestants can I have on my team, and can I make changes during the season?
b2cLanding.faqA3: Your team consists of {{teamSize}} contestants. You can make changes to your team during designated transfer windows, with {{transfers}} transfers allowed per {{frequency}}.
b2cLanding.faqQ4: How does the game rules work, and can players lose points?
b2cLanding.faqA4: Points are awarded based on contestant actions during each episode. Positive actions like winning challenges earn points, while negative events like eliminations can result in point deductions. Check the 'Know the Rules' section above for the complete scoring breakdown.
b2cLanding.faqQ5: How do you win, and are there any prizes?
b2cLanding.faqA5: The player with the most points at the end of the season wins! Prizes and bragging rights vary by league—check with your league organizer for specific rewards.
